sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is the first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 11-04- 2023 by Police Station Banmore, District Morena (MP) in connection with Crime No. 135/2023 registered in relation to the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376, 342, 323 and 34 of IPC, Sections 75 & 3/4 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii),
& 3(2)(va) of SC & ST Act.
Applicant is suffering confinement since 11-04-2023.
As per contents of the bail application and from perusal of the case diary it appears that prosecutrix left her maternal home on her own volition with the present applicant.
They both shared emotional and physical proximity with their consent.

Applicant is a boy aged about 21 years and is a meritorious student as evident from the high-school Suneel Gurjar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95165368/
1 examination certificate where applicant scored more than 75% marks.

sentences.text: Prosecutrix was a married lady and was at the cusp of attaining majority, but because of dispute in her marital relationship, she shared emotional proximity with the present applicant, therefore, it was matter of consent.

Besides,
applicant does not bear any criminal record.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State opposed the prayer, however, he could not dispute the facts as referred above.
Heard.
Perused the case diary.

Considering the contents of the bail application and from perusal of the case diary, it appears that prosecutrix had gone with the applicant on her volition and therefore, case is made out for grant of bail.

Besides, applicant has suffered incarceration since 11-04-2023 with no criminal record,
therefore, in the obtaining facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, it is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail, on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.

The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be; and 7. The applicant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/ prosecutrix side in any manner and shall not move in her vicinity.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
